name: Lower Manhattan Buildings and Parks
description: Lower Manhattan, the Financial District to City Hall. Two parts, as the Discovery Catalog downloads them: parks.geojson, OpenStreetMap's 215 parks, playgrounds and green spaces of longitude -74.018 to -74.004, latitude 40.7 to 40.713, as Autark's parks layer cuts them at that box; and buildings.parquet, the 1,038 buildings of Overture Maps release 2026-09-23.1 in a box about 300 m larger on every side (longitude -74.0215 to -74.0005, latitude 40.6973 to 40.7157), so the towers that shade the parks at its edge are there too, every column as Overture names it, height in metres among them (missing for a few). Both in EPSG:4326. The ShadowsAnywhere test dataflow runs SCOUT's shadow model on them. Built by scripts/build_lower_manhattan_shadows_dataset.py.
sourceLabel: Discovery Catalog: Overture Maps and OpenStreetMap
